_purpose: Per Phase 2-E Codex 2nd review: each synthetic-secret fixture is
tracked here with a SHA-256 hash and a stable invalidity justification.
bench/run.py refuses to execute unless every listed file's hash matches.
This prevents a malicious or careless edit from turning a synthetic
fixture into a real, leakable credential.

fixtures.invalidity_reason: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE / wJalrXUtnFEMI...EXAMPLEKEY are the canonical AWS documentation example credentials; AWS rejects them at API time.
Valid GitHub PATs encode an internal checksum in the trailing characters; an all-zero body fails this checksum and is rejected immediately.
Slack bot tokens require non-zero team and user portions; an all-zero body cannot match any issued token.
npm tokens encode an account-scoped UUID; the all-zero variant cannot match any issued token.
